name: 2C-B-PP
summary: 2C-B-PP, also known as 2,5-dimethoxy-4-bromophenylpiperazine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenylpiperazine family. It acts as an agonist at serotonin receptors, and in studies on rats substituted for DOM with around 10-fold lower potency but similar rates of stimulus-appropriate responding at the highest dose.
